hack.root_cause: Oracle Manipulation (Tellor Price Feed — Instant Value)
hack.description: BonqDAO was manipulated with $175 worth of TRB tokens to report a fake WALBT price — allowing the attacker to borrow 100 million BEUR against 0.1 WALBT and liquidate every other user's collateral, causing $120M in nominal damage while escaping with only ~$1.7M.
